create issue RECIPE: Write eslint-factory/.tmp_issue_body.md, then `jq -Rs '{title,body:.,labels:["eslint","eslint-factory"]}' file.md | safeoutputs create_issue .` directly (no intermediate json file, skips the rm step that gets denied).

dedupe: `gh api "repos/github/gh-aw/issues?state=open&per_page=100&labels=eslint-factory"` (query-string form; -f 403s). Newly-filed issues invisible same-run. `gh api issues/<n> --jq '{state,state_reason}'` for history. `gh api "search/issues?q=repo:github/gh-aw+<rule>+<keyword>"` across all states for a fresh theme.

`gh api pulls/<PR#>/files --jq '.[].filename'` (PR# from HEAD commit's '(#NNNNN)') is the real changed-file list, immune to the shallow-clone all-insertions squash artifact (git log/blame on rules/ confirmed dead 15+ runs).

eslint-factory: no node_modules/dist, npm firewalled, no live lint - ground via Grep on non-test .cjs + rule src/tests. Check for existing eslint-disable-next-line before concluding ungrounded. ALWAYS re-read current rule source + its .test.ts before refiling an expired theme - rules get fixed without the issue being closed as completed (confirmed twice this run).

Issues auto-expire ~1wk TTL, bot-closed not_planned regardless of whether fixed - verify source before assuming 'still broken'. Retire a theme after 2 expiries with no source change; a single expiry proves nothing either way.
